about: Actual in-repository move into the single account-wide search owner. Every original regular file has a replacement mapping except the old empty public export list, whose folder no longer exists. No executable source snapshot or second ranker is introduced.

adaptations: Relative imports and CLI entry locations follow the same implementation into the account-wide search owner. Additional float32 source-mode behavior is qualified separately; no archived bytes count as an active implementation.
